description: Hand-labelled KEEP as opinion. The piece argues a specific, sourced thesis — citing Goldman Sachs' $38B-by-2035 humanoid robotics market forecast, and a contrarian claim that Google/Nvidia/Amazon (not Tesla/OpenAI) will end up acquiring the best robotics startups. That clears the non-obvious-claim bar even with no single reportable event. Contrast case to opinion-zuckerberg-drop.json.
